# InfernoCMS

> A headless CMS for Node.js: define content schemas in TypeScript, get a REST API instantly. PGlite for dev, PostgreSQL for prod, S3-compatible storage, hooks, webhooks, and per-collection access control.

InfernoCMS is a single npm package (`infernocms`) that turns a `content.config.ts` file into a working REST API — no migrations, no scaffolding, no codegen step. Releases follow semver; `0.1.0` ships the API and schema engine. The admin UI is a preview that runs from the [monorepo](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms); a published admin package is targeted for `0.2.0`.

The fastest way to understand the surface is to read the schema introspection endpoint of any running instance: `GET /api/_schema` returns the full set of collections, fields, and shared blocks as JSON.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install infernocms
```

```ts
// content.config.ts
import { defineConfig, field } from 'infernocms';

export default defineConfig({
  collections: {
    posts: {
      fields: {
        title: field.text({ required: true }),
        slug: field.slug({ from: 'title' }),
        body: field.richtext(),
        author: field.relation({ collection: 'authors' }),
        status: field.select({ options: ['draft', 'published'], default: 'draft' }),
      },
    },
    authors: {
      fields: {
        name: field.text({ required: true }),
        bio: field.textarea(),
      },
    },
  },
});
```

```bash
npx infernocms dev
# API: http://localhost:4000
```

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, write a config, run the dev server, hit the API.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/configuration.md): top-level config keys (`collections`, `blocks`, `storage`, `webhooks`, `auth`).
- [Collections](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/collections.md): defining collections, fields, timestamps, and shorthand syntax.

## Field types (17 total)

- [Field types overview](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/overview.md): all 17 types, shorthand syntax, common options.
- Scalar: [text](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/text.md), [number](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/number.md), [boolean](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/boolean.md), [select](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/select.md), [datetime](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/datetime.md), [slug](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/slug.md).
- Rich content: [richtext](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/richtext.md) (Plate-based, stored as JSONB), [blocks](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/blocks.md) (typed flexible content), [link](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/link.md).
- Relationships: [relation](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/relation.md) (single + many-to-many).
- Files: [image and file](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/image-file.md).
- Composite: [group](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/group.md), [array](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/fields/array.md).

## REST API

- [Endpoints](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/api/endpoints.md): full endpoint list, including `/api/_schema`, `/api/_health`, `/api/_upload`, and per-collection CRUD.
- [Query parameters](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/api/query-parameters.md): pagination (`page`, `perPage`), sorting, field selection (`fields`), depth (`depth`), filtering.
- [Filtering](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/api/filtering.md): operators and search syntax.
- [Response format](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/api/response-format.md): standardized `{ data, meta }` envelope and error shape.

## Lifecycle and integrations

- [Hooks](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/hooks.md): `beforeCreate`, `afterCreate`, `beforeUpdate`, `afterUpdate`, `beforeDelete`, `afterDelete`. Async-aware.
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/webhooks.md): outbound HTTP delivery on CRUD events with optional HMAC signing.
- [Access control](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/access-control.md): per-collection, per-operation rules with optional JWT auth.
- [Draft / published workflow](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/draft-published.md).

## Storage and deployment

- [Storage](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/guide/storage.md): local and S3-compatible drivers (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2).
- [Railway](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/deploy/railway.md), [Fly.io](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/deploy/fly-io.md), [Docker](https://github.com/ochoadan/infernocms/blob/main/packages/docs/deploy/docker.md).
